name: Brick Tree (THC Tree)
definition: A hierarchical acceleration structure for voxel ray marching where each parent cube is subdivided into 64 smaller cubes (4x4x4 subdivision per axis) to enable empty space skipping with minimal memory reads.
summary: The Brick Tree is a voxel acceleration structure that reduces GPU memory bandwidth by subdividing nodes into 64 children and using a 64-bit bitmask to skip empty regions without repeated memory reads.
